podcast.title: Mysterious Disappearance in New Mexico (1975)
podcast.body: In 1975, Jim Sullivan was last seen at a ranch near Santa Rosa, New Mexico, after his attempt to restart his career in Nashville faltered. His car was later discovered abandoned with all his possessions still inside, but there was no trace of Jim himself. "He was last seen at a ranch near Santa Rosa, New Mexico. His car was found abandoned with all his possessions. There was no sign of Jim."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Uncharted "Sneak Peak" - Episode 9: The Disappearance of Richey Edwards

podcast.title: 1960s LA Club Scene Musician
podcast.body: Jim Sullivan was an active musician in the Los Angeles club scene during the 1960s. He later attempted to revitalize his career by moving to Nashville in 1975, but this endeavor was unsuccessful. "Jim Sullivan was an interesting dude, playing the LA Club scene in the 1960s."
